summary: Independent opus spec-reviewer, two passes. Pass 1 on 08697d110: REJECT on three items: (1) release.py push-tag ran the tag and trunk push inside the CLI, contradicting BRIEF L42/L217 and programme P4 (outward commands stay literal, no hiding from the guard hook); (2) Step 4 kept shell choreography to satisfy four flag-wiring pins; (3) the pin map was per file, not per test. Fix round 08cb0c15e (orchestrator decision: option B, push-tag only decides and prints status/argv/line, SKILL.md Step 7 keeps the literal push lines): Step 4 fences and history removed, the four pins re-expressed as behaviour tests, a per-test pin table in FINDINGS, golden approver text made honest. Pass 2: PASS, all three closed, F7 satisfied, description word for word, REQUIRED decision written (D41). Round 3 (8f29a1074) only touched the paths-guard allowlist, FINDINGS D44 (deviation from operator F1b for pipeline+guided, open for stop 3), the {trunk} placeholder in the Step 7 line and small push-tag reasons; the spec scope did not change.
